summary.suggested: The Missouri Republican reported that Tom Allen invited his friends to a "free and easy" that evening at his place, No. 417 Washington Avenue, where he would take the chair and serve refreshments.

metadata.notes: masthead reads 'The Missouri Republican--St. Louis, July 16, 1870'

facts.fact: Allen hosted a "free and easy" at his place, No. 417 Washington Avenue, St. Louis, in July 1870
